task_title: Release pipeline: retry logic and auto-close stale issues

plan_review.notes: Concerns resolved: (1) retry step must not use continue-on-error (already planned); (2) explicit outcome==success check in URL resolver; (3) environment URL must reference deploy-url step ID (required, not optional); (4) auto-close filtered to issues >120s old to avoid race conditions; (5) promote-to-prod.yml environment URL also updated; (6) wait increased to 60s.
